the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: every point of G is hit by a K-rational point of G_K and the local ring map is faithfully flat, so the unique-minimal-prime statement reduces to rational points; at a rational point g translation is an automorphism carrying e to g, so all local rings at rational points agree with O_{G,e} and (2) implies (1); for (2) over an algebraically closed field, two components Z_1, Z_2 through e have irreducible product Z_1 x_k Z_2, whose image under multiplication contains both Z_1 and Z_2 (restriction of m to the axes is the identity), forcing Z_1 = Z_2; geometric irreducibility of Z follows since the argument applies over any field extension (source lines 1015-1046)
